panels.description: Explains the incident-triage question and the evidence scopes used on this read-only dashboard. CURRENT ranks suspects from current fleet telemetry in GLOBAL scope; Pipeline and Run ID do not filter suspects. SELECTED RUN uses HTTP-backed evidence for one exact run; run_id never filters Prometheus. No suspects means none were found in the current scope and does not prove the fleet is healthy Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider}.

options.content: GLOBAL signals are not verified causes. Selected-scope status is separate. Telemetry gaps remain UNKNOWN; event age and impact need event evidence.

panels.title: Monitor Selected-Scope Status
panels.description: CURRENT snapshot · Selected pipeline/run_type status at evaluation time. Ranked suspects (2010) are GLOBAL/UNVERIFIED and independent of this card. Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. Not a healthy OK. Ranked suspects may be WORKFLOW/GLOBAL blast radius — check scope labels on tables. Map 0=OK,1=WARN,2=CRIT,3/null=UNKNOWN. Never bare numbers. Confidence from missing telemetry / VALID_EMPTY suspects. Read-only workspace

options.content: Start with ranked suspects; open Action for domain evidence. PENDING means the alert has not fired. Use alert history below to assess timing and impact.

panels.title: Inspect Ranked Suspects
panels.description: GLOBAL · CURRENT at query evaluation time (range end), not SELECTED RUN. Rank is severity order: CRIT=2, WARN=1, UNKNOWN=0; ties have equal urgency, not higher confidence. Confidence is UNVERIFIED: a rule signal alone does not establish cause or impact. Pipeline/provider identifies potential impact scope; confirm with domain evidence. Only active (>0) signals are ranked; telemetry_gap stays UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means no active suspects with available evidence; TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Domain details use the same GLOBAL scope and evaluation time. Rule sample time is not the underlying event time. Inspect retains source labels; Action preserves row scope. TIME RANGE selects evaluation time, not an event-history rank. First screen shows four rows; complete domain evidence remains below. Rank is ordering only, never confidence. Telemetry gaps are observation problems, not confirmed incidents.

links.title: Show all rows and total (summary: up to 4)

panels.title: Monitor Current Alerts
panels.description: GLOBAL · CURRENT firing/pending alerts ranked critical before warning before other/unknown severity, then firing before pending, before the three-row limit. Object labels retain alert instance scope. Open the incident response runbook; full evidence remains below.

links.title: Show all rows and total (summary: up to 3)

panels.title: Track Alert State History
panels.description: GLOBAL · TIME RANGE · ALERTS history, not a persistent incident log. FIRING/PENDING legend names the states; adjacent equal samples merge. Auto labels avoid clipped fragments. Hover a band for full alert name and interval start/end; gaps remain gaps. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING. Outlined intervals use semantic state colors; hover for exact interval boundaries. Gaps mean no observed samples, not OK. State is explicit in the full row label and legend; narrow intervals carry no clipped in-band text.

options.content: Impact: confirm the row’s pipeline/provider. Confidence: UNVERIFIED until domain status and independent evidence agree. UNKNOWN means missing telemetry; it does not identify a cause.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Status
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.
